summary: A library advocate urges that public libraries continue to offer free internet access to ensure equitable information access.

claims.requested_action: keep internet free at public libraries
claims.argument: Public libraries must continue to provide free internet to ensure equitable access to information for those without personal devices.
claims.evidence_quote: Please keep internet  free at the public library.  This can be the only way some people have access to information.  Not everyone owns their own computer and it would be a shame if they no longer had
